package: @astryxdesign/core

## Parameters

| Param | Type | Default | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `options` | `UseComboboxOptions` | - | Configuration object. **(required)** |
| `options.selectableItems` | `ReadonlyArray<T extends {value: string; disabled?: boolean}>` | - | The options in the same order as they render: `SelectorOptionData`, or any option type with a string `value` and an optional `disabled`. Options with `disabled` cannot be picked and are skipped while moving through the open list; ArrowDown or ArrowUp that opens the list from `onKeyDown` lands on the selected option when it is enabled, else on the first or last enabled option. **(required)** |
| `options.isOpen` | `boolean` | - | Whether the list is shown. The caller owns this state. **(required)** |
| `options.onOpen` | `() => unknown` | - | Called to show the list. Return `false` to refuse; the hook then leaves the highlight alone. **(required)** |
| `options.onClose` | `() => void` | - | Called when the hook hides the list; the hook resets the highlight first. When the caller closes the list itself (an outside press, say), it should also call `setHighlightedIndex(-1)`. **(required)** |
| `options.listboxId` | `string` | - | The listbox element's id. Option ids are derived from it through `getItemId`. **(required)** |
| `options.value` | `string` | - | The selected value. Opening the list highlights it when it is enabled; otherwise ArrowUp opens on the last enabled option and ArrowDown, a press, Enter or Space on the first. A disabled option is never highlighted on opening, and with no enabled option nothing is. |
| `options.onSelect` | `(value: string) => void` | - | Called with the picked value. Picking also closes the list. |
| `options.onClear` | `() => void` | - | Clears the value. When provided, Delete or Backspace on the closed control clears it, so clearing is not pointer-only. Ignored while the list is open or with `hasSearch`. |
| `options.hasSearch` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the list has its own search field. Space then types instead of picking, opening by a press or Enter does not pre-highlight (ArrowDown and ArrowUp still open on the selected or the first or last enabled option), and printable keys on the closed control go to `onSearchSeed`. |
| `options.onSearchSeed` | `(char: string) => void` | - | With `hasSearch`, receives each printable character except Space typed while the control has focus, opening the list first when it is closed, so type-to-find needs no separate open step. |
| `options.isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the control ignores clicks and keys. |
